property_summary: For any sendMoney call, the reference contract never reverts (it may fail silently), while the buggy contract reverts if the call fails; the rule asserts that sendMoney never causes the transaction to revert on the reference.
change_summary: Replace _target.call{value: _value}("") with payable(_target).transfer(_value) which reverts on failure instead of returning false, changing sendMoney's error handling behavior.
